description: Configuration for the SUPPLEMENTARY OTRF external-validation workflow. This is fully separate from the frozen 120-scenario primary experiment.

window.note: Deterministic cap on events per scenario after time-ordering. The adapter orders events by (timestamp, file index) and keeps the earliest max_events. Absent evidence is never turned into positive evidence.

notes: OTRF is controlled public adversary-simulation telemetry, not organisational production data.
OTRF results are supplementary and are NOT compared to the 120-scenario accuracy numbers.
Severity is reported descriptively unless the source provides a defensible severity label.
